title: Traceroute Data Set
description: For every TCP connection to an M-Lab server, the Traceroute core service collects network path information from the M-Lab server back to the client IP that initiated the connection. This traceroute collection is done by M-Lab's traceroute-caller which uses traceroute tools like Paris Traceroute and scamper (from the Center for Applied Internet Data Analysis) to collect the actual traceroute data between the M-Lab server and the client. For every TCP connection, traceroute-caller generates two files: traceroute data (scamper1 datatype) and hop annotations (hopannotation1 datatype), which are archived in Google Cloud Storage and parsed into Google BigQuery tables.

accessPoints.label: NDT scamper1 (March 2019 to Present)
accessPoints.description: Compressed tar files containing JSONL-formatted scamper traceroute data for NDT measurement services, organized by date.

accessPoints.label: Host scamper1 (March 2019 to Present)
accessPoints.description: Compressed tar files containing JSONL-formatted scamper traceroute data for the M-Lab host server, organized by date.

accessPoints.label: Neubot scamper1 (March 2019 to Present)
accessPoints.description: Compressed tar files containing JSONL-formatted scamper traceroute data for Neubot measurement services, organized by date.

accessPoints.label: Paris Traceroute (May 2013 to November 2019)
accessPoints.description: Compressed tar files containing unstructured text .paris files from the Paris Traceroute tool, organized by M-Lab server and date.
